## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `swift test`
- [ ] `swift build -c release`
- [ ] App bundle built and verified when UI or packaging changed

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private endpoints, inventories, or
      unredacted diagnostics are included
- [ ] New network access or subprocess behavior is documented
- [ ] Test fixtures are synthetic
